title: CanIds
description: The CAN identifiers of the stack bus of HYDRA-UMC (standard 11-bit identifiers): the identifier of the emergency stop, the base of the slot windows, the width of a window and the number of slots, and the messages of a slot, each as an offset inside the window with the one node that may send it. The identifier of a message is slot_base + slot * slot_window + offset (checked by the clients: it must fit in 11 bits, and an offset must be inside the window). The schema is closed.

estop_id.description: The identifier of the emergency stop frame, one for the whole stack.

slot_base.description: The identifier where the window of slot 0 starts.

slot_window.description: How many identifiers a slot owns.

offset.description: Inside the window of a slot.
